target_name: Raise Absorbed by Creditors and Dealmaking
rationale: The MIN cap is only binding for issuers, so the entire lower (long) tail collapses to net share repurchases scaled by assets — i.e., the published net-stock-issuance/payout anomaly with no intangible content — and the archive already contains a closely related dollar-scaled net-flow measure ("Shareholder Cash In Minus Research Dollars Added," fmb -4.25).

target_name: Diverted Proceeds at a Retreating Research Firm
rationale: This is a near-duplicate of the already-evaluated "Rescue Equity at a Retreating Research Firm" (MIN(sstk,dltr) × identical retreat conditioner, alpha -3.3%, t -3.28) with |Δgdwl| bolted on, and the product of a two-sided financing leg with a non-negative rank amplifies both tails, so the long leg becomes big repurchasers *with* retreating research — the opposite of the stated economics.

target_name: Issuance by Acquisitive Firms Currently Transacting
rationale: Both conditioners are already-evaluated goodwill measures built from the same variable with nearly identical statistics (alpha -2.0%/-2.3%, Sharpe -0.46/-0.50) attached to the identical net-issuance leg, so averaging their ranks is a cosmetic blend rather than a new mechanism.

target_name: Raise Shipped Straight Back Out to Claimholders
rationale: Adding dvc to dltr inside the MIN and swapping sstk for net issuance leaves this essentially the archived "Rescue Equity at a Retreating Research Firm," and because dvc is zero for most R&D-reporting firms the incremental economic content of the "dividend recipients" channel is negligible.

target_name: Net Cash Returned With Research Expanding
rationale: A single-operator change from the gen-6 signal, but the gross-versus-net payout distinction is economically meaningful and the archive's two bracketing results (alpha without slope, slope without alpha) give a genuine diagnostic reason to test the interpolation, though much of the incremental variation is the known net-issuance effect.

target_name: Years of Research Bought With Paper
rationale: Well-constructed and internally consistent — the MIN isolates the jointly issued-and-capitalized dollar amount, the R&D-budget denominator is the scaling that produced the archive's strongest slopes, and winsorization plus IND_RANK controls the small-denominator blow-up — with the caveat that stock-financed-acquirer underperformance is itself a documented result, so the novelty rests on the R&D scaling.
